app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

id.description: Ref ID to scroll into view or scroll inside of. DO NOT SPAM. If action fails or loops, STOP calling this tool and use browser_map to re-evaluate the page state.

label.description: Element label to scroll into view.

selector.description: CSS Selector of the element to scroll into view.

tab_id.description: Execute in a specific tab instead of active. DO NOT SPAM. If action fails or loops, STOP calling this tool and use browser_map to re-evaluate the page state.

target.description: Alternative element identifier or query to scroll into view.
